tool_input.description: Exercise shared parser flags and exit codes on rotate.sh and verify.sh
Run ad-hoc flag and exit-code checks

result:
The two scratch files live in `/tmp` (deleting them needs a permission I'm not going to burn — they're inert helper scripts, nothing in the repo).

All 11 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh` → `all tests passed`), plus ad-hoc checks confirmed every shared flag (`--dest=`, `--keep=`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, `--`), the `--keep 0`/bad-value/unknown-option/missing-dir exit codes (1/1/1/2), dry-run deletes nothing, and binary-mode/malformed sidecars parse correctly.

What was done:

- **`rotate.sh`** — bug 1: the archive list is sorted oldest-first, so the surplus is now the *oldest* `total - keep` entries (`head -n $((total - keep))` instead of `tail -n +"$keep"`, which deleted the newest), and the early exit is `total -le keep` so exactly N archives deletes nothing.
- **`verify.sh`** — bug 2: the sidecar line is now split into digest + *entire* remainder (handles `name with spaces` and binary-mode `*name`) instead of `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated at the first space; the digest comparison is quoted (`[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`).
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option parser, `is_uint`, `need_value`, the `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`, with a double-source guard in the same style as `lib/log.sh`; sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (they define `usage`/`parse_local_option` first, as before). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — one rotate group (exactly-`--keep` deletes nothing; past-`--keep` deletes the oldest with its sidecar, newest three remain) and one verify test for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` verifying `ok` with rc=0.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
